Accessed September 4, 2014. |website = {{URL|https://www.ridgewoodnj.net/}} |footnotes = }} '''Ridgewood''' is a [[Village (New Jersey)|village]] in [[Bergen County, New Jersey|Bergen County]], in the [[U.S. state]] of [[New Jersey]]. Ridgewood is a suburban [[commuter town|bedroom community]] of [[New York City]], located approximately {{convert|20|miles}} northwest of [[Midtown Manhattan]].Capuzzo, Jill P.[https://www.nytimes.com/2022/06/29/realestate/ridgewood-nj.html "Living In Ridgewood, N.J.: A Historic Suburb With a View of the City"], ''[[The New York Times]]'', June 30, 2022. Accessed August 1, 2022. As of the [[2020 United States census]], the village's population was 25,979, an increase of 1,021 (+4.1%) from the [[2010 United States census|2010 census]] count of 24,958, which in turn reflected an increase of 22 (+0.1%) from 24,936 in the [[2000 United States census|2000 census]].[https://www.nj.gov/labor/labormarketinformation/assets/PDFs/census/2010/2010data/table7cm.xls Table 7. Population for the Counties and Municipalities in New Jersey: 1990, 2000 and 2010], [[New Jersey Department of Labor and Workforce Development]], February 2011. Accessed May 1, 2023. It is consistently one of the state's highest-income communities. While in 2000 its [[per capita income]] of $51,658 was ranked the [[List of New Jersey locations by per capita income#New Jersey places ranked by per capita income|35th-highest]] in the state, in 2020, the per capita income for the past 12 months in the period 2020-2024 was $93,733, relatively maintaining its ranking at [[List of New Jersey locations by per capita income|41st-highest]] in the state.
